roles.title: Lead Architect
roles.summary: Lead Architect on a hardware-backed identity platform for high-assurance sectors: government, defence, healthcare, finance, critical infrastructure. Verification happens in hardware, at the person, the device and the platform.

roles.title: Lead Architect
roles.summary: Lead Architect on a hardware-anchored identity and authentication platform. Nearly eight years across the token, the services behind it, and the integrations into customer environments.
highlights: Built and led the platform from its first commit: a C# codebase across the Windows logon integration, a browser SDK, and a remote-desktop client.

Built a compile-time white-labelling system that ships one product under multiple customer brands from a single source tree. Per-brand COM identity with shared installer upgrade codes, so a rebranded build installs over its predecessor instead of beside it.

Rebuilt the Windows logon integration from a blocking call into a cancellable state machine. Worst-case wait on a wrong card went from about two minutes to about 45 seconds; cancel went from impossible to sub-second.
Cut about 1.4 seconds of fixed cost from every sign-in by instrumenting the path first, then removing a duplicated directory lookup and a synchronisation wait that was firing on every attempt.
Traced an intermittent contactless-auth failure to the device side by ruling out every host-side cause with controlled tests, and narrowed an open-ended vendor request to one specific fix.

roles.title: Lead Developer and Architect
roles.summary: Lead Developer and Architect on a video-transcoding and DIT tool for editors, colourists and post houses: a Windows client for ProRes-on-Windows, H.265 and bulk ingestion, backed by an AWS platform for accounts, cloud storage, transcoding and team sharing.

roles.title: Lead Applications Developer & Integration Architect
roles.summary: Nearly nine years at an advertising-content delivery company. Started in computational programming and design, moved to UX team lead, then led applications development and integration architecture. C#/.NET, media processing, and broadcaster integrations across Australia and New Zealand.
highlights: Progressed from computational programmer and designer (2008) to UX team lead (2012) to lead applications developer and integration architect (2014).
